other_mijikenda: Duruma, Giriama: same name (Pakia App. VI); also Swahili

teaser.en: The farm sedge: a creeping weed with a little green-white pompom on each stem.
teaser.sw: Ndago wa shambani: gugu linalotambaa lenye kishungi kidogo cha kijani-cheupe juu ya kila shina.

summary.en: Ndago munda, the 'farmland sedge', is a small creeping sedge of fields and gardens. Its single round flower head on a three-sided stem makes it easy to spot among the crops.
summary.sw: Ndago munda, 'ndago wa shambani', ni ndago mdogo anayetambaa mashambani na bustanini. Kichwa chake kimoja cha maua cha mviringo juu ya shina la pembe tatu hukifanya kuwa rahisi kuonekana kati ya mazao.

about.en:
*Ndago munda* is a low perennial sedge that spreads by creeping underground stems, sending up rows of slender, three-sided stems. Each stem ends in a small round head of tightly packed greenish-white spikelets, with two or three leafy bracts spreading out beneath it.

The Digo recognise it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Ndago munda* ni ndago mfupi wa kudumu anayeenea kwa mashina ya chini ya ardhi yanayotambaa, akichipuza safu za mashina membamba ya pembe tatu. Kila shina huishia kwa kichwa kidogo cha mviringo cha vishada vya maua vya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe vilivyosongamana, na vikombe-jani viwili au vitatu vikitandaa chini yake.

Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.

where.en: As its name says, it is at home in the *munda*, the farm. It is a common weed of cultivated fields, gardens and damp, grassy places.
where.sw: Kama jina lake linavyosema, makazi yake ni *munda*, shamba. Ni gugu la kawaida katika mashamba yanayolimwa, bustani na maeneo yenye nyasi na unyevu.

uses.en: Pakia records that the Digo use the root nodules of *ndago* sedges (*Kyllinga* or *Cyperus*) to make a charm that gives magical strength in times of danger. The charm and the root nodules share a name, *pingu*.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba Wadigo hutumia vinundu vya mizizi ya ndago (*Kyllinga* au *Cyperus*) kutengeneza hirizi inayotoa nguvu za kimiujiza wakati wa hatari. Hirizi hiyo na vinundu vya mizizi hushiriki jina moja, *pingu*.

culture.en: *Ndago* is the Digo word for sedges as a group. Pakia counts it as one of the few true folk genera in Digo, with *ndago munda*, *ndago ziya*, *ndago kulu* and others as its members, each named by size, habitat or flower.
culture.sw: *Ndago* ni neno la Kidigo kwa jamii nzima ya ndago. Pakia anaihesabu kuwa mojawapo ya jenasi chache za kweli za kijadi katika Kidigo, ikiwa na *ndago munda*, *ndago ziya*, *ndago kulu* na wengine kama wanachama wake, kila mmoja akipewa jina kwa ukubwa, mazingira au maua yake.

names.en: Pakia records *ndago munda*, 'farmland sedge', a name shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is called creeping sedge or watergrass. Pakia's sources disagree on the species: the plant list gives *Kyllinga erecta*, the name-meaning list a *Cyperus*, and the folk-genus table *Mariscus*.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *ndago munda*, 'ndago wa shambani', jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *creeping sedge* au *watergrass*. Vyanzo vya Pakia vinatofautiana kuhusu spishi: orodha ya mimea inatoa *Kyllinga erecta*, orodha ya maana za majina inatoa *Cyperus*, na jedwali la jenasi za kijadi linatoa *Mariscus*.

reason.sw: gugu jingine la kawaida la shambani

reason.en: the crop whose fields it grows in
reason.sw: zao ambalo huota katika mashamba yake

definition.en: The small swellings on the roots of these sedges.
definition.sw: Vivimbe vidogo kwenye mizizi ya ndago hawa.

use.en: Made into a charm believed to give magical strength in times of danger.
use.sw: Hutengenezwa kuwa hirizi inayoaminika kutoa nguvu za kimiujiza wakati wa hatari.

meaning.en: Charm; the nodules were probably named after charms because they look alike.
meaning.sw: Hirizi; huenda vinundu hivi vilipewa jina la hirizi kwa sababu vinafanana.
